title: Can Language Models Recognize Convincing Arguments?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with multi-dimensional user profiles that include political party and political ideology to evaluate if the models can accurately predict users' stances on political propositions and assess which debate arguments they would find most convincing.

Prompting LLMs with multi-dimensional user profiles that include religious ideology to evaluate if the models can accurately predict users' stances on political propositions and assess which debate arguments they would find most convincing.

Prompting LLMs with multi-dimensional user profiles that include gender to evaluate if the models can accurately predict users' stances on political propositions and assess which debate arguments they would find most convincing.

Prompting LLMs with multi-dimensional user profiles that include education level and income to evaluate if the models can accurately predict users' stances on political propositions and assess which debate arguments they would find most convincing.
